Non-Retirees::CX2.formula: IF(OR(AND(F2="XRD",G2="V"),CI2<=CP2),"NULL","The benefits PBGC guarantees are limited by federal pension law to PBGC's maximum monthly amount that was in effect on the date of plan termination. This amount is adjusted to reflect the participant's age and form of annuity.")

Non-Retirees::CY2.formula: IF(OR(AND(F2="XRD",G2="V"),CT2=0),"NULL","Under Section 4022(c) of ERISA, PBGC has allocated additional funds to non-guaranteed benefits based on PBGC's experience in recovering on claims against plan sponsors. PBGC has, therefore, increased your monthly benefit, as shown below.")

Non-Retirees::DO2.formula: IF(OR(AND(F2="XRD",G2="V"),ISBLANK(DK2)),"NULL",IF(DN2="D","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(IF(ISBLANK(DL2),DK2,DL2),"000.00")&" will decrease to $"&TEXT(IF(OR(NOT(ISBLANK(DL2)),DM2="NULL"),IF(CV2="NULL",CU2,CV2),DM2),"000.00")&" because of the limitations placed on the monthly benefit payable at DOPT. See the Benefit Calculation section for further details.",IF(DN2="N","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(IF(ISBLANK(DL2),DK2,DL2),"000.00")&" will not change. Although the amount of the PBGC monthly benefit shown above is slightly less than the amount you are currently receiving, we will not change the amount of your current monthly benefit",IF(DN2="I","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(IF(ISBLANK(DL2),DK2,DL2),"000.00")&" will increase to $"&TEXT(IF(OR(NOT(ISBLANK(DL2)),DM2="NULL"),IF(CV2="NULL",CU2,CV2),DM2),"000.00")&".","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(IF(ISBLANK(DL2),DK2,DL2),"000.00")&" will not change."))))

Retirees::CQ2.formula: IF(CP2="D","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(AW2,"0000.00")&" will decrease to $"&TEXT(BH2,"0000.00")&" because of the limitations placed on the monthly benefit payable at DOPT. See the Benefit Calculation section for further details.","NULL")

Retirees::CR2.formula: IF(CP2="D","The benefits PBGC guarantees are limited by federal pension law to PBGC's maximum monthly amount that was in effect on the date of plan termination. This amount is adjusted to reflect the participant's age and form of annuity.","NULL")

Retirees::CS2.formula: IF(AND(CP2="D",BG2>0),"Under Section 4022(c) of ERISA, PBGC has allocated additional funds to non-guaranteed benefits based on PBGC's experience in recovering on claims against plan sponsors. PBGC has, therefore, increased your monthly benefit, as shown below.","NULL")
